articles.title: Cancellation Policy Overview
articles.body:
StayBridge cancellation policies are determined by your hotel's partner tier.

PREMIUM HOTELS (24-hour window): Cancel 24 hours or more before check-in for 100% refund minus $15 service fee. Cancel less than 24 hours before check-in: no refund.

STANDARD HOTELS (48-hour window): Cancel 48 hours or more before check-in for 100% refund minus $15 service fee. Cancel 24-48 hours before: 50% refund minus $15 service fee. Cancel less than 24 hours before check-in: no refund.

BUDGET HOTELS (7-day window): Cancel 7 days or more before check-in for 100% refund minus $15 service fee. Cancel 2-7 days before: 75% refund minus $15 service fee. Cancel 24-48 hours before: 50% refund minus $15 service fee. Cancel less than 24 hours before check-in: no refund.

Non-refundable bookings receive no refund regardless of timing.

PLATINUM CUSTOMER BENEFIT: Platinum tier customers cancelling 24 hours or more before check-in receive 100% refund with service fee waived (regardless of hotel tier).

ENTERPRISE CORPORATE BENEFIT: Enterprise tier corporate accounts cancelling 48 hours or more before check-in receive 100% refund (service fee retained).

Contact support with your booking reference for your specific cancellation terms and refund calculation.

articles.title: Modification Policy
articles.body:
You can modify booking dates, guest count (adults and children), room type, or board type (meal plans) through our support team.

MODIFICATION FEES BY TIMING: Changes 7 days or more before check-in are FREE. Changes 2-7 days before check-in: $25 base fee. Changes 24-48 hours before check-in: $50 base fee. Same-day changes (less than 24 hours before check-in): $60 base fee, requires hotel partner approval.

IMPORTANT - BUDGET HOTELS: Same-day modifications are NOT available at budget tier hotels. If you need to change a booking at a budget hotel within 24 hours of check-in, you must cancel and rebook (cancellation fees apply).

HOTEL TIER ADJUSTMENTS: Premium hotels apply 50% discount to fees. Standard hotels use standard fees. Budget hotels add 50% surcharge to fees.

MULTIPLE MODIFICATIONS: Your second modification adds $15 to the fee. Third and subsequent modifications add $30 to the fee.

BOARD TYPE OPTIONS: You can change between without breakfast, with breakfast, half-board (breakfast + dinner), full-board (all meals), or all-inclusive (meals + drinks + amenities) at any time.

PLATINUM CUSTOMER BENEFIT: Platinum customers receive free modifications when booking changes are made 24 hours or more in advance.

ENTERPRISE CORPORATE BENEFIT: Enterprise tier corporate accounts receive free modifications at any time (hotel approval still required for same-day changes at non-budget hotels).

Contact support to request a modification.

articles.title: Corporate Account Benefits
articles.body:
Corporate account benefits are tiered based on your company's account level.

ENTERPRISE TIER: Net 60 payment terms, monthly consolidated invoicing with detailed reporting, $200,000 credit limit, 1% monthly late payment fee. Booking modifications are always free (no approval required). Cancellations 48 hours or more before check-in receive 100% refund (standard $15 service fee retained). Same-day modifications allowed with hotel confirmation (not available at budget hotels). Up to 50 rooms per booking.

MID-MARKET TIER: Net 45 payment terms, monthly consolidated invoicing, $50,000 credit limit, 1.5% monthly late payment fee. For bookings under $1,000: standard modification fees apply. For bookings $1,000 or more: modifications require manager approval, fees waived if approved. Cancellations with 24-hour notice receive fee waiver. Up to 15 rooms per booking.

SMALL BUSINESS TIER: Net 30 payment terms, per-booking invoicing, $10,000 credit limit, 2% monthly late payment fee. Standard modification fees apply (same as individual bookings). Cancellations with 48-hour notice receive fee waiver. Up to 5 rooms per booking.

All corporate accounts receive priority support and simplified expense reporting. Contact your account manager for assistance.

articles.title: Group Booking Guidelines
articles.body:
Group bookings (2 or more rooms) follow special policies based on total group size.

SMALL GROUPS (2-5 rooms): Modifications 7 days or more before check-in are free. Changes 2-7 days before incur $25 per room (adjusted by hotel tier). Changes 24-48 hours before require hotel confirmation and incur $50 per room (adjusted by hotel tier). Same-day changes incur $60 per room and require hotel approval.

MEDIUM GROUPS (6-15 rooms): Modifications 7 days or more before check-in are free. Changes 2-7 days before incur $25 per room with hotel notification (adjusted by hotel tier). Any changes within 48 hours require mandatory hotel partner approval and incur $50-$60 per room depending on timing. Budget hotels require approval for any changes within 7 days.

LARGE GROUPS (16+ rooms): Most modifications require hotel partner approval as these are treated as contract modifications. Exception: At premium partner hotels, large group modifications 7 days or more before check-in do not require hotel approval.

HOTEL TIER FEE ADJUSTMENTS: Premium hotels offer 50% discount on per-room fees. Standard hotels use base fees. Budget hotels add 50% surcharge to per-room fees.

Group coordinators should plan changes well in advance. Contact support with your group booking ID for modification assistance.

articles.title: Refund Processing Timeline
articles.body:
Once your refund is approved by our support team, processing follows this timeline:

INTERNAL PROCESSING: 3-5 business days from approval to refund initiation.

PAYMENT METHOD TIMELINES: Credit card refunds appear within 5-10 business days after processing. Debit card refunds appear within 5-10 business days. Bank transfers may take 7-10 business days. Other payment methods vary by provider.

CONFIRMATION: You will receive an email confirmation with your refund transaction ID (format TXN-########) once processing begins. This transaction ID can be used to track your refund status.

REFUND AMOUNT: Your refund will reflect the cancellation policy applicable to your booking, which may include deduction of a $15 service fee depending on timing and customer tier. Platinum customers receive service fee waivers when cancelling 24 hours or more before check-in.

If you have questions about a pending refund or need to verify refund amount calculations, contact support with your booking reference number and transaction ID.
